checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja and radare2 both recover one function 0x00510010-0x005114F3 (5348 bytes, 143 blocks, 212 edges); angr CFGFast recovers the exact entry with 157 nodes and no unresolved jumps. The candidate is a 7-block driver Terrain_DecodeChunkCommands at 0x00458930 (121 bytes) plus decode_chunk_record at 0x00455dc0 (9772 bytes, 251 blocks) in igi1.exe 35d92a3a. The block-count difference is the documented helper decomposition.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail is cdecl with no stack arguments: the sole caller 0x0050FE60 pushes none, the body reads no incoming stack slot, and it ends in a single retn at 0x005114F3. The candidate declares std::int32_t Terrain_DecodeChunkCommands() with the same no-argument cdecl contract (abi-adapted namespaced symbol).

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Reviewed constants: 0x30-byte record stride; record header fields +0x18 level, +0x1C flags, +0x20 node pointer, +0x24 packed token, +0x28 neighbour token, +0x2C cache; g_b16ca4/g_b16c9c/g_c31090 and the descriptor arrays g_b12c60/g_b12c5c; pool selection limits -3 for A/B/C and promotion limits -2 with size thresholds 0xC80/0x1F40; material page scale 1/256 and origin loads; 6-bit fields at shifts 14/20/26 biased by 0x18; vertex scale 1<<(0x1B-level), /3.0, height bias -64.0 then *256; header word (first<<16)|total. The candidate uses the same values (source sections labelled with the retail VAs).

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: The candidate reads and writes the same retail locations through candidate storage: record header +0x18..+0x2C, chunk header +0x18/+0x1C, the three pool handle/map/base/stride sets, g_b16c9c/g_b12c60/g_b12c5c, the material-page tables (0x00BA80B0), texture modifiers (0x00BA2030) and neighbour modifiers (0x00BA5050). Declared deviations: unresolved table contents are zero-initialised candidate storage, the 0x24-byte per-vertex metadata uses a heap vector instead of the retail stack area, and the material-descriptor loop is bounded to 32 entries.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Retail is a leaf: no call instructions and no indirect jumps (the six Binary Ninja 'callees' at 0x00C35040 are rep-movs artifacts). The candidate decomposes the per-record body into decode_chunk_record plus static helpers, which introduces internal calls but no external side effects; the observed writes are the same descriptors, pools, chunk buffers and caches.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Every retail path returns the entry value of g_b16ca4: the early count<=0 path returns it directly and the loop path returns the same saved count after g_c31090 += count and the per-record processing. The candidate saves count, adds it to g_c31090, returns count when <=0, loops decode_chunk_record over count records and returns count.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The candidate models retail x87 80-bit intermediates with float/double and FISTP as truncation, and the x87 control word was not observed. Exact floating-point semantics are therefore not reproduced or claimed; this check is out of scope for a structural review. The deviation is recorded in the limitations.

limitations: Status STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED covers retail CFG recovery (143 blocks/212 edges, Binary Ninja = radare2; angr 157 nodes with no unresolved jumps) and a stage-by-stage source review. It is not block-for-block equivalence: the candidate is a 7-block driver plus a 251-block decode_chunk_record helper, and the per-record stage ordering was checked against the decompiled decision points rather than matched block-for-block.
No differential execution or paired runtime capture exists for this native; the 733-call observation with EAX 0x1F3/2/2/1 is retail-only.

Runtime-populated tables (0x00BA2030, 0x00BA5050, 0x00BA80B0, 0x00C28FE4, 0x00C30080) and the pool limits/base/stride are unresolved; the candidate models them as zero-initialised storage and pointer_from_bits yields invalid addresses without retail initialisation.

The candidate uses a zero-initialised heap vector for the 0x24-byte per-vertex metadata where retail uses a fixed stack area of unrecovered extent, and bounds the material-descriptor loop to 32 entries; retail's corresponding bound was not independently established.
x87 80-bit intermediates are modelled with float/double and FISTP as truncation; exact floating-point semantics are not modelled or claimed (the review marks floating_point_semantics not_applicable).
The GameNatives reference scripts/GameNatives/terrain/00510010-Terrain_DecodeChunkCommands.cpp is a different, trivial wrong candidate and is not used.
